narrator.narr_title: The Daily Bulb presents... Lightbulb Moment!
narrator.narr_sunday: Hot off the press! Pick a page, any page.
narrator.narr_fail_2: Well. That's one way to end it.
narrator.narr_finale_end: And that, dear readers, is how everyone had a bright idea. The End. Really, this time.
narrator.narr_dinner_intro: Dinner time. Two hungry mouths. One fish.
narrator.narr_dinner_original: The Dog ate the fish. As usual.
narrator.narr_dinner_twist: The CAT ate the fish! The Dog never saw it coming. Literally.
narrator.narr_nap_intro: A lazy afternoon. The fire is warm, the cake is waiting, and the Boss has plans.
narrator.narr_nap_original: The Boss ate the cake. Nobody was surprised.
narrator.narr_nap_twist: The DOG ate the cake, and the Boss napped in the dog bed. Promotion denied.
narrator.narr_greens_intro: The Kid has a choice: a cookie, or broccoli. Guess which.
narrator.narr_greens_original: The Kid ate the cookie. Of course he did.
narrator.narr_greens_twist: The Kid ate the BROCCOLI! Stop the presses!
narrator.narr_snack_intro: Midnight. One pie. The fridge hums. Everyone is definitely asleep.
narrator.narr_snack_original: The Kid ate the pie, and the Cat ran clean out of the comic.
narrator.narr_snack_twist: The DOG ate the pie! The Kid slept through the whole thing.
narrator.narr_catmouse_intro: Cat. Mouse. You know how this one goes.
narrator.narr_catmouse_original: The Cat chased the Mouse right out of the comic.
narrator.narr_catmouse_twist: The MOUSE bonked the CAT, and the Dog got the cheese! Small, but furious.
narrator.narr_birthday_intro: It's the Boss's birthday. There is cake. There is always cake.
narrator.narr_birthday_original: The Boss ate his own birthday cake. Happy birthday, Boss.
narrator.narr_birthday_twist: The DOG ate the Boss's cake! Best birthday ever. For the Dog.
narrator.narr_revenge_intro: Grandma is in a mood. Nobody knows why. Nobody dares to ask.
narrator.narr_revenge_original: Grandma bonked the Dog. Poor Dog.
narrator.narr_revenge_twist: Grandma bonked the BOSS, and the Dog got the cake! Justice, served with frosting.
narrator.narr_finale_intro: Late at the office. The lights are out, and so are the ideas.
narrator.narr_finale_original: The Boss and the Intern had the same bad idea.
narrator.narr_shadow_intro: Grandma rules the living room. A tall bookshelf hides the cake, and its shadow hides more.
narrator.narr_shadow_twist: The BOSS bonked GRANDMA! Grandma has met her match.
narrator.narr_powercut_intro: The power's out. Only your bulb, one lamp pedal and one spare bulb. The cake is somewhere in the dark.
narrator.narr_powercut_original: The Mouse ran right out of the comic.
narrator.narr_powercut_twist: The Mouse napped in the armchair, and the DOG ate the cake. Good Dog.
narrator.narr15_title: The Bulb Family Funnies! Narrated by me. Obviously.
narrator.narr15_nearmiss: Ha! Almost! Almost ruined it. Not quite.
narrator.narr15_fail_2: As written. As intended. As it should be.
narrator.narr15_new_shy: New feeling! SHY. Shine a light on them and they run for the nearest shadow.
narrator.narr15_new_love: New feeling! IN LOVE. They hug the nearest person, and the love spreads. Disgusting.
narrator.narr15_new_jealous: New feeling! JEALOUS. They want whatever the nearest person wants. Just like real people.
narrator.narr15_act1: Good evening. I am the Narrator. I have narrated four thousand comics, and not one of them has ever had a twist. Please keep your hands, paws and lamps inside the margins.
narrator.narr15_act2: Act Two. I have spoken to my lawyer. My lawyer says lamps cannot be sued. My lawyer is also a lamp now. I don't want to talk about it.
narrator.narr15_act3: Act Three. No more Mister Nice Narrator. I know where the fuse box is.
narrator.narr15_dinner_intro: Dinner at the Bulb house. Every night for eleven years, the Dog has eaten the fish. It is a classic. It is tradition. It is, frankly, the only joke I have.
narrator.narr15_dinner_original: The Dog ate the fish. Ha. Ha ha. Classic.
narrator.narr15_dinner_win: The CAT ate the... Who moved my lamp? Somebody MOVED my LAMP.
narrator.narr15_greens_intro: Page two. A boy. A cookie. And a head of broccoli that has sat on that table, untouched, since 2009. The broccoli is decorative.
narrator.narr15_greens_original: The Kid ate the cookie. Of course he did. He's a child, not a rabbit.
narrator.narr15_greens_win: A child. Ate broccoli. On purpose. Nobody is going to believe this. I'm not sure I believe this. Somebody check him for a fever.
narrator.narr15_nap_intro: Sunday. The Boss has invited himself over, which is how the Boss gets invited anywhere. There is cake. Today, the Boss eats his first cake. Boss Cake Count: zero. For now.
narrator.narr15_nap_original: The Boss ate the cake. Hard work pays off.
narrator.narr15_nap_twist: The DOG ate the cake. The BOSS napped in the dog bed.
narrator.narr15_nap_win: The Dog ate the Boss's cake, and the Boss is asleep in a dog bed, drooling on a squeaky bone. Boss Cake Count: still zero. The Dog has been promoted.
narrator.narr15_snack_intro: Midnight. The Kid creeps towards the last slice of pie. Grandma is asleep. The Cat is terrified of the Kid, for reasons we do not discuss.
narrator.narr15_snack_original: The Kid ate the pie, and the Cat ran clean out of the comic. Crime pays.
narrator.narr15_snack_win: The Kid fell asleep in an armchair halfway through a crime, and the Dog ate the evidence. Best-organised heist this house has ever seen.
narrator.narr15_stage_intro: The Bulb Family Talent Show! The Kid will sing. The Kid is shy, so the Kid will not sing. The Boss will do impressions of himself. There is a prize cake.
narrator.narr15_stage_original: The Kid hid from the spotlight. The talent show was cancelled due to a lack of talent.
narrator.narr15_stage_twist: The BOSS hid from the spotlight. The DOG ate the prize cake.
narrator.narr15_stage_win: The Boss, a man who once gave a ninety-minute speech about his own parking space, hid from a lightbulb. The Dog won the talent show. His talent was cake. Boss Cake Count: still zero.
narrator.narr15_birthday_intro: It's the Boss's birthday. He planned the party himself, sent himself a card, and signed it 'from everyone'. This year he WILL eat the cake. Boss Cake Count: zero. That changes today.
narrator.narr15_birthday_original: The Boss ate his birthday cake. Finally. Happy birthday, sir.
narrator.narr15_birthday_twist: The DOG ate the birthday cake.
narrator.narr15_birthday_win: Happy birthday, Boss. The Dog says thank you for the cake. Boss Cake Count: zero. Dog Cake Count: I've stopped counting. The Dog has his own accountant now.
narrator.narr15_revenge_intro: Sweet, gentle Grandma. She knits. She bakes. She has bonked eleven people this week, and it's Tuesday. Tonight she is coming for the Dog.
narrator.narr15_revenge_original: Grandma bonked the Dog. The Dog had it coming. Probably.
narrator.narr15_revenge_twist: Grandma bonked the BOSS. The DOG ate the cake.
narrator.narr15_revenge_win: Grandma bonked the Boss at his own leftover-birthday-cake party, and the Dog ate the leftovers. Boss Cake Count: still zero. I'm starting to think it's personal.
narrator.narr15_date_intro: The office party. The Intern, Gary, is in love with the Boss. The Boss is furious about everything. The Cat is here for the free buffet. Nobody knows why Grandma is here.
narrator.narr15_date_original: The Intern hugged the Boss. HR has been notified. HR has notified HR.
narrator.narr15_date_twist: The Intern hugged the Boss. The Boss hugged GRANDMA.
narrator.narr15_date_win: The Intern hugged the Boss. The Boss hugged Grandma. Grandma has booked a church. I wrote a workplace drama, and you have turned it into a romance. A horrible, beautiful romance.
narrator.narr15_shadow_intro: Lamp, listen. Let's make a deal. You leave this page alone, and I'll write you a page of your own. You can be the hero. A lamp hero. Grandma bonks the Kid behind a bookshelf. Lovely. Nobody touch it.
narrator.narr15_shadow_original: Grandma bonked the Kid. He knows what he did.
narrator.narr15_shadow_win: The Boss bonked Grandma. GRANDMA. I'll have to phone Grandma's lawyer. Grandma IS Grandma's lawyer. We had a DEAL, lamp.
narrator.narr15_slice_intro: The morning after the Boss's birthday. One slice of cake survived. One. And the Intern, Doug? Dave? Doug, is jealous of everyone. Which is fair. Nobody has ever invited him to anything.
narrator.narr15_slice_original: Grandma ate the last slice. The Boss ran off screaming. The Dog slept through it. A quiet morning.
narrator.narr15_slice_twist: Grandma and the Dog CLONKED heads over the armchair. The INTERN ate the last slice.
narrator.narr15_slice_win: The Intern ate the last slice. The INTERN. He wasn't even invited to this PAGE. Meanwhile Grandma and the Dog knocked each other out over an armchair neither of them owns. Boss Cake Count: zero. Intern Cake Count: ONE. The Boss has asked HR to investigate.
narrator.narr15_powercut_intro: Right. If you're going to ruin my comic, you can ruin it in the DARK. There. Power's off. Good luck twisting what you can't see, lamp. ...Is that a spare bulb? Where did you get a SPARE BULB?
narrator.narr15_powercut_original: The Mouse ran out of the comic. Smart Mouse.
narrator.narr15_powercut_twist: The MOUSE napped in the armchair. The DOG ate the cake.
narrator.narr15_powercut_win: I cut the power. You brought a spare bulb. Who carries a SPARE BULB? The Mouse is asleep in an armchair like a tiny retired accountant, and the Dog has eaten the cake in total darkness. By SMELL.
narrator.narr15_catmouse_intro: I've hired a professional. One Cat, paid in advance, in fish. The Cat will chase the Mouse out of this comic, and then the Cat will chase YOU out of this comic. Get him, Cat.
narrator.narr15_catmouse_original: The Cat chased the Mouse out of the comic. Money well spent.
narrator.narr15_catmouse_twist: The MOUSE bonked the CAT. The DOG got the cheese.
narrator.narr15_catmouse_win: The Mouse bonked the Cat. A MOUSE. Bonked. A CAT. I paid that cat in fish. I want my fish back. The Dog ate the cheese. The Dog doesn't even LIKE cheese.
narrator.narr15_haunted_intro: New genre. HORROR. It was a dark and stormy night. The Bulb family entered the haunted house. There is a coffin. There is a cake, for some reason. Be afraid, lamp. BE VERY AFRAID.
narrator.narr15_haunted_original: The Kid ran screaming from the haunted house, and the Mouse hid in the dark. Terrifying. I scared myself.
narrator.narr15_haunted_twist: The BOSS took a nap in the COFFIN.
narrator.narr15_haunted_win: The Intern bonked the Mouse in the dark, and the Boss climbed into a coffin for a nap. He says it's the best sleep he's had in years. He's ordered one for the office. This was a horror story. The scariest thing left in it is the Boss's snoring.
narrator.narr15_wedding_intro: Grandma and the Boss are getting married. Yes. Because of one hug on page eight. I take no responsibility. The Cat has been asked not to object. The Cat has objected to everything since 2016.
narrator.narr15_wedding_original: The Cat objected. Grandma was bonked at her own wedding. Lovely ceremony. Very moving.
narrator.narr15_wedding_twist: The CAT hugged the MOUSE. The DOG ate the wedding cake.
narrator.narr15_wedding_win: The bride hugged the Cat. The Cat hugged the Mouse. The groom is still looking for the cake, which the Dog ate. By the power vested in me by absolutely nobody, I now pronounce this... whatever this is. You may hug the Mouse.
narrator.narr15_finale_intro: The last page. I have no tricks left. No power cuts, no cats, no ghosts. Just a nice, quiet ending where nothing happens. Please. I'm begging you. Let nothing happen.
narrator.narr15_finale_original: The Boss and the Intern had the same bad idea. Nobody else had any idea at all. The End. Quietly.
narrator.narr15_finale_win: Everyone... everyone had a... The Dog has the cake AGAIN. Boss Cake Count: ZERO. Fifteen pages! ZERO! Fine. FINE. It's funnier. Your version is funnier. You win, lamp. ...That was my lightbulb moment. THE END.
